verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents DML statements for deleting data from tables (bigquery-docs-2), and Iceberg managed tables keep data in customer-owned storage buckets (bigquery-docs-10). That gives users direct deletion control and some control over where data lives. Time travel (bigquery-docs-44) shows historical data is kept, but the pack never documents configurable retention windows or expiration policies, so the retention half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: table/dataset expiration or retention-period configuration, controls over time-travel and deleted-data retention, guarantees about deletion from backups, independent or hands-on corroboration.
